appKeyTip: Are you sure you want to recreate the key? The previous key will be invalid after recreation. Please keep the new key safe.
homeGuide: Click the icon in the upper right corner to switch between organizations you have joined; click the application name in the upper left corner to switch between purchased applications.
homeOrgGuide: You can create a new organization by selecting "New organization" when purchasing an app from "All apps" on the left; you can also join a new organization by accepting an invitation from others.
homeUserGuide: Click "All members" on the left, then click "Invite member" in the lower right corner, you can invite other colleagues to join via email.
inviteMemberTip: The invitee will receive an email. After clicking the link in the email to register and log in, the invitee must confirm the invitation to join.
inviteResult: Invitation emails have been sent to {0}. Please wait for the invitee to accept the invitation.
localUrlsHelp: JSON string, format: [{"web":"https://web","api":"https://api","help":"https://help"}]. Do not set or modify it at will.
purchaseExists: The selected organization has already purchased this app
